headline: Red Sox scratch out an extra-inning thriller to save the season
morning_brew: Finally, a win that doesn't make me want to launch my Dunks into the neighbor's yard. That win over the Mariners was pure, unfiltered stress, but it beats the hell out of the absolute disaster we saw against New York. It wasn't pretty, and the bullpen had me sweating through my shirt, but finding a way to gut out an extra-inning victory is exactly how you keep your head above water in this league. Seeing Aroldis Chapman shut the door in the tenth was like a cold shower of relief after the garbage fire I watched all week.

The bats did just enough to keep us afloat, and while the pitching had me convinced they were actively trying to lose, they managed to lock it down when it actually counted. I am not saying we're back to being a championship contender, but at least we aren't rolling over like we were twenty-four hours ago. Linda from Lynn told me earlier that she'll believe in this team when she sees us in October, and honestly, she is the only person in the Hub making any sense right now.

We have a quick turnaround with another date against Seattle tonight at Fenway, so there's no time to toast this one. We need to carry this pulse into the next game and start stringing some wins together before the schedule gets even nastier. If we keep fighting like we did in those final frames, maybe, just maybe, I can stop freezing my deposits to the Duck Boat fund and get a little breathing room after this painful stretch of misery.

news_digest.headline: Chisholm Jr., Yankees criticize Red Sox radio voice Flemming
news_digest.dans_take: The Yankees should worry about their own messy dugout instead of what's being said in our booth.

news_digest.headline: Ben Brown to re-sign with Patriots after release
news_digest.dans_take: It's just a depth move, but any kind of stability on the roster right now is a win in my book.

trend_watch.trend: Perfect tenth inning to close out the win
trend_watch.dans_take: About damn time someone came in and did their job without turning the ninth inning into a cardiac event.
That was a brutal night at the dish, but he needs to find his rhythm before I lose my mind.

trend_watch.trend: Allowed three runs in a third of an inning
trend_watch.dans_take: I watched that half-inning through my fingers and I don't think I can handle a sequel to that horror movie.
